activity.role: Islamic jurist moving to Egypt and developing his mature legal teaching
activity.role_display_name_ko: 이집트로 이주해 법학 이론을 발전시킨 이슬람 법학자
activity.notes: Al-Shafi'i's relocation from Baghdad to Egypt is usually dated around 814 CE/199 AH. A modern encyclopedia notes differences between biographical accounts of his earlier Iraq-Hejaz itineraries, so this records only the approximate Egyptian resettlement and legal scholarship, not an exact day or a year-by-year detailed trajectory. Political setting in Egypt was within the Abbasid era, while central administrative control fluctuated; active_in never claims he served the Abbasid court or governor.

sources.title: al-Shāfiʿī — Encyclopedia of Religion (Encyclopedia.com)
sources.citation_text: Discusses al-Shafi'i leaving Iraq and moving to Egypt, with variants in transmission including a move in 814 and his final years teaching in Egypt.

sources.title: Muhammad ibn Idris al-Shafi'i — World Biography (Encyclopedia.com)
sources.citation_text: Places his last Baghdad visit about 814 and subsequent move to Egypt, where he wrote his mature legal system.
